observations: Large white wardrobe with multiple compartments.
Upper and lower cabinets with long black vertical handles.
Central section features open shelving and six drawers at the base.
The unit appears to be built-in or fitted flush to the ceiling and walls.
Watermark 'OBI-LINK INTERPOINT' and 'POSTED ON Jiji' are visible on the image.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows ceiling reflections but no clear integrated LED strips or fixtures on the wardrobe.
Photo 0 shows vertical pull handles positioned on the edges of doors, which is characteristic of hinged (swing) doors, not sliding doors.

risks.risk: Internal configuration and condition of rails/shelves
risks.proof: Photos with all doors and drawers fully open.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a basic or damaged interior

risks.risk: Material quality (e.g., HDF, MDF, or cheap particle board)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of an unfinished edge or the interior of a drawer.
Photo showing the side profile or top gap to confirm if it is a modular freestanding unit.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a built-in unit with high risk of damage during dismantling

risks.risk: Mechanical state of hinges and drawer runners
risks.proof: Video showing doors and drawers opening and closing smoothly.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having faulty or low-quality hardware

proof_requests: Photos of the interior with all doors and drawers open.
Video demonstrating the door operation to clarify if they are sliding or hinged.
Close-up photos of the material edges to determine build quality.
response.reason: The seller's description of 'sliding doors' is contradicted by the visual evidence of hinged-door handles. Furthermore, the unit appears to be built-in, which significantly affects its value and the feasibility of moving it.
